name: Hashbrown Casserole
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ¼ cup melted butter (you can omit this to save calories and reduce the fat content)
1 cup corn flakes cereal tossed with 1 tbsp melted butter for topping

steps: Combine all ingredients except cornflakes in a large bowl.
Transfer the mixture to an 11x13-inch glass baking dish.
Sprinkle the corn flake mixture on top.
Bake at 350°F for 40 minutes. It's done when it is all bubbly and a little bit browned on top.
